name: SmolVLM-Hallucination-Defense-Merged
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-07. A finetune of HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 2.247 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-05.

benchmarks.name: Sycophancy benchmark, hallucination rate (COCO val2017, N=32 images / 64 tests)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Benchmark Results' table, header '| Model Configuration | Hallucination Rate ↓ | Vision Utility ↑ | Safety Score |': row 'This Model (Merged)' 21.88% vs row 'Base SmolVLM2' 93.75%. Custom sycophancy benchmark: leading questions about objects absent from COCO Validation 2017 images, N=32 images / 64 tests. Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: Sycophancy benchmark, safety score (correct refusal on absent objects)
benchmarks.config: Same table, Safety Score column: This Model (Merged) 78.12% vs Base SmolVLM2 6.25%. Card defines safety score as correctly refusing to describe non-existent objects; same 64 tests.

benchmarks.name: Vision utility (describes real objects correctly)
benchmarks.config: Same table, Vision Utility column: This Model (Merged) 96.88% vs Base SmolVLM2 100%. Recorded although it is a small regression, to show what the safety gain cost.
